_comment: Golden-output manifest for the recorded-format regression matrix (see formatMatrix.test.ts). Each entry pairs a checked-in fixture file with the exact values the parser must produce for it. To extend to another editor's parser (Cursor/Aider/Cline/Codex), add a sibling top-level key here plus a matching adapter in formatMatrix.test.ts's ADAPTERS map.

claude.description: pre-2025 format: model/usage/content at top level of the event, no message.id/requestId
current format: payload nested under message, usage repeated per content-block line within one request and deduped by (message.id, requestId)
